newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends lower as Thai price again eyed.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends lower as Thai price again eyed.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower as world rice markets, especially the benchmark Thai price, remained undervalued relative to U.S. export prices, traders said.

"We're still battling the same battle. The Thai market at $320.00 per tonne and we're (U.S.) about $420.00," a trader said. Traders also said U.S. farmers are selling or hedging rice and storing their soybeans because rice remains at a strong price.
Rice closed four cents per cwt lower to two higher, with November down two at $9.88 per cwt.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 250 contracts, down from 413 Friday, according to the CBOT.
Rice options volume was estimated at 20 contracts, down from 100 Friday.
